scene_type: 2D (top-down drone view, with mild perspective: see camera.perspective)
time_convention: t = frame / fps, frame 0 at t = 0
pixel_coords: x right, y down, full-resolution pixels
description: Near-nadir drone shot of a suspension-bridge deck (grey asphalt, monochrome footage). Two cars drive downward (toward image bottom, +y) in the same left lane, one behind the other: a white car entering at the top and a dark car leaving at the bottom. No other vehicles or people.

events.event: clip start: both cars already moving downward
white car fully inside frame (rear edge leaves top border)
dark car front bumper reaches bottom border (starts leaving)
dark car last visible (rear sliver ~20 px)
clip end, white car still moving

no_events: no stops, contacts, lane changes or direction reversals; both cars keep driving straight down the lane

camera.motion: frames 0-23: static to <1 px. From ~frame 24 a slow zoom-out (or climb): background scale factor (frame i -> frame 0) 1.0009 @27, 1.0058 @33, 1.0151 @39, 1.0250 @43, plus <=8 px drift and ~0.1 deg rotation. Per-frame similarity transforms in scripts/camera_motion.csv (columns a,b,tx,c,d,ty map frame-i pixels to frame-0 pixels). Track columns stab_* are positions mapped into frame-0 coordinates.
camera.perspective: camera slightly tilted: ground scale grows toward the image bottom. Deck width 1317 px at y=100 -> 1474 px at y=3700 (+12%), approx deck_width(y) = 1317 + 0.0436*y at frame 0. Objects lower in frame appear larger (dark car ~472 px vs white car ~450 px).
camera.apparent_size_over_time: white car length 457 (f11-17) -> 435 raw / 446 stabilised (f43); dark car ~467 (f0) -> ~486 (f20).
